Maya (CS): Heads-up - FlightPath hit three friction points during onboarding demo today. Renewal conversation in ~7 weeks. Can product/eng weigh in on prioritization?
Ethan (CS): Notes from the session:
- Search returns old marketing snippets instead of product specs after their CSV import.
- They asked for environment-scoped API keys so staging and prod traffic billing don't mix.
- Large backfills (their S3 -> ingestion) fail silently at ~30k rows.
Sam (PM): From product: search/document relevance is P0 (blocks internal adoption). Env-scoped keys are P1 (security + billing clarity). Backfill robustness P2.
Lee (ENG): Need a repro payload and a request id. Also which ingestion path are they using (UI vs API)?
Maya (CS): They used the API bulk endpoint. Example sanitized payload they shared:
```
{"text":"Accelerometer calibration guide v1","model":"rbw-sim-1.2","metadata":{"customer":"flightpath"}}
```
Request id: fp-2026-07-11-9921.
Ethan (CS): Customer quote: "Search finds our blog posts, not our engineering docs. Useless for triage."
cs-bot: Created ticket CS-5177 and linked ENG-2324.
Sam (PM): Proposed immediate steps:
1) ENG triage (48h) to confirm whether vectorization or routing maps to the wrong model. Assign: Lee.
2) Product RFC for env-scoped keys (spec + billing impact).
3) CS to collect two more failing examples and the exact ingestion call sequence.
Lee (ENG): I'll take the triage. Plan: reproduce with their payload, run nearest-neighbor checks across our vector stores, and verify fallback model mapping. Expect update in 48h.
Maya (CS): I'll set customer expectation to 48h and ask for additional samples.
Ethan (CS): I'll block a 20-minute enablement call post-mitigation to walk their ops team through best practices.
Sam (PM): If ENG finds routing bug, we'll fast-track a patch. Otherwise consider improving default model selection for CSV imports.
Maya (CS): Internal notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/flightpath-onboard-07-2026 (internal). Closing for now; will post triage results here.
